translations.text: Our Father who art in heaven. Our Father, thou art in heaven. It is a very great and godly thing that a man calls the almighty Lord his father.
It is fitting, then, that every man make himself worthy of this: to be a son of God. Hallowed be thy name. Hallowed be thy name.
We have no need to pray that his name be hallowed, for it always was holy and always is;
rather, we pray that his name be hallowed in us, and that the holiness we received from him in baptism we may bring before him, kept safe, on the Day of Judgment.
Thy kingdom come. May thy kingdom come. His kingdom always was and always is; rather, we pray that his kingdom come to us and that he reign in us,
not the devil, and that his will rule in us, not the devil's enticement. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
May thy will be done, as it is in heaven, so on earth: that, as unceasingly and as honourably as the angels in heaven fulfil thy will, we may now fulfil it in the same measure.
Give us this day our daily bread. Give us our daily bread at all times. In these words all our bodily needs are included.
But now, for eternity [?], grant us, Lord, thy body and thy blood, which we receive from the altar,
that it may come to us for eternal salvation and for eternal life, not for punishment; and keep thy grace and thy love fully in us.
And forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. And forgive us our debts, just as we forgive our debtors.

It is a great necessity for every man to reflect on himself with these words: that every man should forgive his companion and his brother their misdeeds with all his mind and heart, so that the Lord may likewise forgive him his own.
If he will not forgive his companion, then he says, "Forgive us as we forgive." And lead us not into temptation. And do not bring us into temptation.
Do not let us, Lord, be tempted by the devil as far as his will would have it, but only so far as we can overcome with thy grace and thy mercies.
But deliver us from evil. But save us from all sins, past, present and future. Amen.
